action.description: add records an item, list shows your open items, done closes one.

what.description: For add: the step in one line. The wake message repeats it.

due.description: For add without after: an RFC 3339 time, or a duration such as 45m from now.

reply.description: A message id: due when its conversation gets a reply from the recipient.

change_step.description: A change id: due when a step of the change moves.

ask_closed.description: An ask id: due when the ask closes.

after.description: For add without due: exactly one key.

blocker.description: For add: none (default: you are woken), owner (the chief asks the owner, no wake), or a session id (the chief chases that session, no wake).
